limitations: Question author already has extensive historical knowledge of source and prior retrieval outputs; questions are not blind independent.
Each reference is a bounded source-described fact, not an independently established global authority or implementation state.
Questions and expected source labels are frozen before any new 60/20 corpus draw or baseline run; no post-result editing.
One required source per task does not prove it is the only useful source; additional citations are not a negative.
Preliminary navigation pass checks source recall and evidence feasibility, not full fresh-agent answer or B0-B4 viability.
The nine legacy scenarios remain separate, unmodified and not scored.
The formal Research 513 thresholds are not changed and no original C02 holds are resolved.
